purpose: Worked examples supporting the proposed OBDb polling convention; review metadata, not signalset definitions or approved vehicle changes.
classification_basis: Local decoded metadata and proposed ordinary-use rules only. Confidence rates semantic classification, not physical decoder validation or achieved cadence. Every proposal retains existing filters, debug status and routes.

examples.rationale: Wheel speed, steering angle and vehicle acceleration are immediate driving feedback. All eight fields fit Operational.

signals.name: Front right wheel speed, high resolution
Front left wheel speed, high resolution
Rear right wheel speed, high resolution
Rear left wheel speed, high resolution

examples.rationale: Vehicle speed drives the entire HVAC packet. Module name and majority of temperature fields must not slow the speed signal.

Two drive motor speed fields drive this 32-signal battery packet if used as immediate driving feedback. Lifetime energy counters, SOC, temperature and isolation fields inherit the command interval; they do not acquire the same intrinsic meaning.
examples.review_requirement: Confirm motor speeds are wanted as driving feedback before adopting this faster packet. Cell extrema provisionally use 5 seconds for cell balance/dispersion trends; their cell-number indices inherit that meaning. Confirm this intended use; health-only use could justify 60 seconds. Transport cost of this long response needs later profile review.

examples.rationale: SOC/remaining energy are ordinary charge-state monitoring; SOH is degradation monitoring. None is an accumulated-history total. Three fields share 60 seconds.
examples.review_requirement: Use-dependent SOC exception: faster sampling requires an explicit load/charge-transition use case.

examples.rationale: Main/400V relay states, relay requests and socket connection are present equipment states. Inlet temperatures inherit the 5-second command interval.
examples.review_requirement: An application requiring faster transition acquisition needs an explicit use-case exception and review.

examples.rationale: Heated steering-wheel on/off is a convenience state. Being a binary state does not automatically make it Operational. Both alternate decodes retain existing availability.
Tire sensor IDs are static identity/configuration, not pressure, temperature or accumulated history. The guide treats these as connection/setup discovery rather than recurring measurement polling.
examples.review_requirement: Use connection/setup or on-demand discovery policy. Preserve the existing 60-second interval pending a separate discovery-policy decision; no seventh tier is introduced.

examples.rationale: Live traction-battery current follows acceleration/regeneration power demand. Electrical does not always mean Short-term trends.
Standalone SOH describes degradation/condition, not charge level or historical total. The observed 3,600-second interval would become 60 seconds under strict interval standardization.
examples.review_requirement: This is 60 times as many nominal requests; explicitly review whether strict uniformity should override a justified slower health refresh.

examples.rationale: Standalone odometer is a persistent accumulated distance total; being displayed live does not make it Operational.
RPM and road speed drive a packet also containing load, airflow, intake temperature, coolant and barometer.
examples.review_requirement: Classification is clear, but the proposed packet requests four times the current nominal traffic. Review transport capacity before adoption.

examples.rationale: Current oil temperatures drive a packet whose previous-trip distance is a historical snapshot.
Battery cooling inlet temperature concerns thermal conditioning, unlike combustion intake-air temperature at 5 seconds. The word intake alone is insufficient.
Numeric tire pressure is periodic condition monitoring. Preserve extended address eax 2A, tester address tst 2A, response address and flow-control flag.
Standalone displayed/estimated SOC fits periodic remaining-charge monitoring under the proposed default.
examples.review_requirement: Hybrid SOC can be materially useful at 5 or 1 seconds for energy-management transitions; establish intended ordinary use rather than assuming every percent signal belongs at 60 seconds.

examples.rationale: Short-term fuel trim is a live combustion correction. The phrase short term must not be mistaken for the Short-term trends tier.
Combustion intake-air temperature is an intake trend, matching the BMW baseline exception to bulk Thermal condition.
Engine coolant tracks warm-up and sustained thermal state.
Atmospheric pressure is environment; pressure units do not imply fuel/boost response at 1 second.
Latest cycle could mean a short combustion window or a completed drive cycle. The name does not establish temporal semantics, so no ordinary category is proposed.
examples.review_requirement: Preserve the observed 1-second interval. Establish the counting window, reset behavior and intended use: live event acquisition could warrant Engine control at 1 second, while a completed-cycle historical total could fit Cumulative history at 300 seconds.

examples.rationale: DPF differential pressure varies with exhaust flow/load, fitting powertrain-response observation.
examples.review_requirement: Meaning is named but unit is unknown; retain debug-year handling and require decoding evidence before ordinary promotion. Absent rax must stay absent.

signals.name: Diesel particulate filter differential pressure variant 2

examples.rationale: DPF outlet temperature fits ordinary thermal condition; a focused regeneration diagnostic profile could request faster sampling.
examples.review_requirement: Do not assert 15 seconds captures all exhaust transients; the chosen ordinary use must be explicit.

examples.rationale: Distance since regeneration accumulates between reset events and fits history. A resettable total is not necessarily fast.
examples.review_requirement: If the actual desired use is detecting regeneration completion, use an explicit event/state signal or a documented override; 300 seconds may miss reset timing.

examples.rationale: The packet mixes a counter-steering active bit, steering torque, and odometer at last activation. Current versus captured-event semantics of torque/state are unclear; the current 900-second interval cannot establish meaning.
examples.review_requirement: Do not accelerate from 900 to 0.25 seconds based on steering keyword. Decode/document whether fields are live or stored snapshots; then current driving feedback could drive 0.25 seconds, while historical capture could be 300 seconds.

signals.name: Counter steer support, odometer, last activated

examples.rationale: Time since last regeneration sounds cumulative, but a 32-bit field divided by 10066666667 and max 0.426 minutes is a concrete decoding inconsistency to review.
examples.review_requirement: Resolve identity/scaling first; retain the current 1-second interval and all availability flags. Do not normalize a plausible label into a claim of validated decoding.

examples.rationale: Target/actual high fuel pressure and low fuel pressure track changing engine load and remain Engine control.
Measured soot mass is periodic filter loading/condition, unlike instantaneous differential pressure or regeneration-state transitions.
examples.review_requirement: Unit is unknown; verify semantics/units before rollout and retain all availability flags.

examples.rationale: Distance since battery cable disconnection accumulates over a resettable maintenance epoch. It remains history despite a possible reset.

signals.name: Distance since last battery cable disconnection
